# Portfolio Website - Halim Choukani

This is a personal portfolio website built with Next.js 15, React 19, and TypeScript. The site showcases professional experience, projects, skills, education, and contact information.

## Site Structure

### Main Page (`/`)
Single-page layout with the following sections in order:

1. **Hero** - Introduction with name, title, and call-to-action
2. **About** - Professional summary and background
3. **Skills** - Technical skills organized by category
4. **Experience** - Work history with roles, companies, and achievements
5. **Projects** - Featured projects with descriptions and tech stacks
6. **Education** - Academic background
7. **Contact** - Contact form and social links

### Navigation
- Fixed navbar with smooth scroll to sections
- Mobile-responsive hamburger menu
- Sections: Home, About, Skills, Experience, Projects, Education, Contact

## Key Components

| Component | Path | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| Hero | `app/components/Hero.tsx` | Landing section with animated text, CTA buttons |
| About | `app/components/About.tsx` | Professional bio and summary |
| Skills | `app/components/Skills.tsx` | Categorized skill tags (frontend, backend, tools, etc.) |
| Experience | `app/components/Experience.tsx` | Timeline of work experience |
| Projects | `app/components/Projects.tsx` | Project cards with links to GitHub/live demos |
| Education | `app/components/Education.tsx` | Academic degrees and certifications |
| Contact | `app/components/Contact.tsx` | Contact form with validation, social links |
| Navbar | `app/components/Navbar.tsx` | Responsive navigation with scroll spy, theme toggle |
| Footer | `app/components/Footer.tsx` | Copyright and social links |
| CustomCursor | `app/components/CustomCursor.tsx` | Custom cursor effect (theme-aware) |
| ThemeProvider | `app/components/ThemeProvider.tsx` | React context for theme state (light/dark/system) |
| ThemeToggle | `app/components/ThemeToggle.tsx` | Theme switcher button in navbar |

## Technical Stack
- **Framework**: Next.js 15 (App Router)
- **Language**: TypeScript
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS v4 with CSS custom properties
- **Font**: Syne (display) + Space Mono (monospace) via next/font
- **Deployment**: Vercel

## Theme System
- **Light/Dark/System modes** with persistence via localStorage
- **CSS custom properties** for all semantic colors (`--bg`, `--surface`, `--accent`, `--text`, `--text-muted`, `--border`, etc.)
- **Automatic system preference detection** via `prefers-color-scheme`
- **Manual toggle** in navbar (cycles: Light → Dark → System)
- **OLED-friendly dark mode** (`#020617` near-black background)
- **High contrast ratios** meeting WCAG AA (4.5:1 minimum for normal text)
  - Light: `#0f172a` on `#ffffff` (16.3:1), `#475569` on `#ffffff` (5.8:1)
  - Dark: `#f8fafc` on `#020617` (15.3:1), `#94a3b8` on `#020617` (5.2:1)
  - Accent: Teal `#00876b` (light) / `#00f5c4` (dark) — both 4.5:1+ on respective backgrounds

## API Endpoints
None - This is a static portfolio site with client-side only functionality.

## Data Sources
All content is hardcoded in component files. No external CMS or database.

## Contact Information
- Email: Available in Contact component
- GitHub: Linked in Footer and Contact
- LinkedIn: Linked in Footer and Contact
- Twitter/X: Linked in Footer and Contact

## SEO & Metadata
- Open Graph tags in `app/opengraph-image.tsx`
- Twitter cards in `app/twitter-image.tsx`
- Sitemap generated via `app/sitemap.ts`
- Robots.txt via `app/robots.ts`
- Web app manifest via `app/manifest.ts`

## Accessibility
- Semantic HTML5 elements
- ARIA labels on interactive elements
- Focus-visible styles (2px solid accent ring, 2px offset)
- Color contrast compliant (WCAG AA 4.5:1 minimum for all text)
- Reduced motion support (`prefers-reduced-motion` disables animations)
- Theme-aware focus and selection styles
- Keyboard-navigable theme toggle with ARIA attributes
- Visible focus states in both light and dark modes

## Performance
- Static generation (SSG) for all pages
- Optimized images via Next.js Image component
- Font optimization via next/font
- Code splitting by route/component

## Development
```bash
npm run dev     # Start development server
npm run build   # Production build
npm run start   # Start production server
npm run lint    # Run ESLint
```
